Name: hotkey hub
Author: tangsuanz
Description:
[center][size=6]Hotkey Hub [/size][/center]
[left]A lightweight overview panel for your keybindings. Hotkey Hub scans the config.json of every mod you have installed, lists all keybinds in one searchable view ([b]mod / action / keybind[/b]), and lets you [b]trigger any binding with a single click[/b]. You can also add custom entries that don't belong to any mod. No more digging through a dozen config files just to look up one key.

一个轻量的快捷键总览面板：自动扫描你安装的所有 mod 的 config.json 键位，按「mod 名 / 功能名 / 快捷键」列成一张可搜索的列表，[b]点一下就能直接帮你触发那个快捷键[/b]；也支持手动添加不属于任何 mod 的自定义条目。再也不用为了查一个键跑去翻十几个 mod 的配置了。
[/left]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53820/53820-1791860022-733685703.png[/img]

[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]One-page overview[/b] — automatically scans every installed mod's
[code]config.json[/code]and gathers all keybinds into a single panel.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]GMCM first[/b] — when GMCM is installed, registered keybinds are read from GMCM's keybind page first, so names come straight from the GMCM settings page (author-localized display names — the most accurate) and coverage is fuller.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Smart localization[/b] — when a config key doesn't match its i18n key, a three-tier fallback (candidate keys + known aliases + fuzzy matching) kicks in to keep names readable.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Live search[/b] — filter the list instantly by mod name, action name, key, or note.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Jump to settings[/b] — every auto-detected mod row has a [b]GMCM[/b] button that opens that mod's page inside GMCM in one click.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Manual entries[/b] — add any key (e.g.
[code]LeftControl + M[/code]) as a custom row and write your own note.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Rename / annotate / delete[/b] — rename, annotate, or remove any row; renaming a mod updates all of its entries at once.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]功能特性[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]一键总览[/b]：自动扫描所有已装 mod 的
[code]config.json[/code]，把散落各处的键位汇总到同一个面板。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]GMCM 优先[/b]：装了 GMCM 时，优先从 GMCM 的「快捷键」聚合页读取已注册键位——名字直接取自 GMCM 设置页（作者本地化的显示名，最准），覆盖也更全。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]智能中文[/b]：字段名与 i18n 键名对不上时，用「候选键 + 已知别名 + 模糊相似度」三重保底，尽量显示中文。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]实时搜索[/b]：顶部搜索框按 mod 名 / 功能名 / 按键 / 备注即时过滤。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]直达设置[/b]：每个自动识别的 mod 行尾有「GMCM」按钮，一键打开该 mod 在 GMCM 里的设置页。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]手动添加[/b]：可把任意按键（如
[code]LeftControl + M[/code]）作为自定义条目加进来，并自己写备注。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]改名 / 备注 / 删除[/b]：对每条都能改名、写备注、删除；改某个 mod 的显示名会同步该 mod 的所有条目。[/*]
[/list]
[heading]Usage[/heading]
Opening the panel
[b]Press [/b][size=2][font=Monaco, Menlo, Consolas, monospace]. [/font][/size][b](the period key — 2nd key to the right of [/b][size=2][font=Monaco, Menlo, Consolas, monospace]M [/font][/size][b], between [/b][size=2][font=Monaco, Menlo, Consolas, monospace], [/font][/size][b]and [/b][size=2][font=Monaco, Menlo, Consolas, monospace]/ [/font][/size][b]) to open the panel.[/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53820/53820-1791860303-307405830.png[/img]

[list]
[*]The open key can be changed to any single key or key combo in [b]GMCM (Generic Mod Config Menu)[/b].[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Press . again to close the panel.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]使用方法[/heading]
打开面板
[b]默认按 [/b][size=2][font=Monaco, Menlo, Consolas, monospace]. [/font][/size][b]键（句号键，位于 [/b][size=2][font=Monaco, Menlo, Consolas, monospace]M [/font][/size][b]右边第 2 格、夹在 [/b][size=2][font=Monaco, Menlo, Consolas, monospace], [/font][/size][b]和 [/b][size=2][font=Monaco, Menlo, Consolas, monospace]/ [/font][/size][b]之间）打开面板。[/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53820/53820-1791860497-1435024521.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]这个按键可以在 GMCM（通用 Mod 设置菜单） 里改成任意单键或组合键。[/b][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]打开后再次按 [b][size=2][font=Monaco, Menlo, Consolas, monospace]. [/font][/size][/b][/b][b]即可关闭。[/b][/*]
[/list]
[b]UI overview
Main panel — a search box at the top with Add / Rescan buttons; the list has three columns: Keybind / Description (action name + mod) / Note, with Edit / Delete or Edit / GMCM buttons at the end of each row.[/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53820/53820-1791860791-1437319296.png[/img]

[b]Manual add form[/b] — fill in [b]mod / action name / keybind / note[/b]; the keybind can be captured by simply pressing the combo.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53820/53820-1791860802-1113565644.png[/img]

The in-game screenshots above show the Chinese UI. The panel follows your game language — English-language games show an English UI.


界面说明
[b]主面板[/b]——顶部搜索框 + 「添加 / 重新扫描」按钮；列表三列：[b]快捷键 / 说明（功能名 + 所属 mod）/ 备注[/b]，行尾是「编辑 / 删除」或「编辑 / GMCM」按钮。

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53820/53820-1791860823-1260362558.png[/img]

[b]手动添加表单[/b]——填「所属 mod / 功能名称 / 快捷键 / 备注」，快捷键可直接按组合键录入。

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53820/53820-1791860833-1811649981.png[/img]
[color=#fafafa][size=4]Installation[/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Requirements: [b]StardewUI[/b] ,Generic Mod Config Menu ( Optional, recommended ) .[/*]
[*]Extract  Hotkeys-0.1.0.zip into Stardew Valley/Mods/ , giving you Mods/Hotkeys/.[/*]
[*]Launch the game and press . to open the panel.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]How each feature works[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Trigger a keybind[/b] — click any row to press that key for you.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Rename / add a note[/b] — click the edit button on a row. Changes are stored only in this mod's own
[code]config.json[/code]and [b]never modify the target mod's files[/b], so updating or uninstalling leaves no residue.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Delete[/b] — manual entries have a delete button at the end of the row.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Show unbound keys[/b] — tick "Show unbound keybinds" in GMCM to also list keys whose value is
[code]None[/code].[/*]
[/list]

[heading]安装[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]前置依赖：[b]StardewUI, Generic Mod Config Menu（可选，推荐）[/b]。[/*]
[*]把 Hotkeys-0.1.0.zip 解压到 Stardew Valley/Mods/下，得到 Mods/Hotkeys/
。[/*]
[*]启动游戏，按 . 打开面板。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]各功能怎么用[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]触发快捷键[/b]：点某一行即可直接触发该键位（相当于帮你按了一下那个键）。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]改显示名 / 写备注[/b]：点行内编辑按钮。修改只存在本 mod 自己的
[code]config.json[/code]里，[b]不改动目标 mod 的任何文件[/b]，升级或卸载都不会留下残留。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]删除[/b]：手动添加的条目行尾有删除按钮。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]显示未绑定[/b]：在 GMCM 里勾选「显示未绑定键位」，可把值为
[code]None[/code]的键位也列出来。[/*]
[/list]
